subject: general
question: 'The forty minutes raga’ is an album composed by _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ali Akbar Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ali Akbar Khan was an Indian Hindustani classical musician of the **Maihar Gharana,** known for his virtuosity in playing the** sarod.**
 
• He was the **son of** the legendary sarod player** Allauddin Khan**, a major figure in Indian classical music.
 
• He performed widely both in** India and abroad**, gaining international acclaim.
 
• Khan was awarded the** Padma Bhushan in 1967** and the **Padma Vibhushan in 1989**.
 
• He founded the **Ali Akbar College of Music in Kolkata in 1955** and later established another branch in** California, USA, in 1967.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amjad Ali Khan:- **

 
 
• He is a celebrated Indian classical musician known for his exceptional skill on the **sarod,** a traditional string instrument.
 
• He is the son of the renowned sarod player **Hafiz Ali Khan.**
 
• He is awarded with **Padma Bhushan (2001) and the Padma Shri (1991).**
 
 
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia:-**
 
 
• He is a highly esteemed Indian classical **flutist.**
 
• He** trained** with eminent musicians including the legendary flutist **Pandit Ravi Shankar and Ustad Bismillah Khan.**
 
• He is awarded with **Padma Bhushan (1992) and Padma Shri (1984).**
 
• He is known for his** innovative approach to the bansuri**, expanding its repertoire and techniques.
 
 
 
• **Bhimsen Joshi:-**
 
 
• He is one of the greatest **Indian vocalists from Karnataka**, in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• He was renowned for his expertise in the **Khayal genre **of Hindustani classical music.
 
• He was awarded with the **Padma Bhushan (1970), the Padma Vibhushan (1998)**, and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• He was also awarded the **Jnanpith Award,** one of India's highest literary honors, in **1999 **for his contributions to Indian music.
